content: मन्थर {%a.%} [मन्थ्-अरच्] .²1 Slow, dull, tardy, lazy, inactive; गर्भन्थरा <ls>Ś. 4</ls>; प्रत्यभिज्ञानमन्थरोऽभवत् {%<ab>ibid.</ab>%}; स्थाने खल्वयं प्रसवमन्थरोऽभूत् <ls>M. 5</ls>; दरमन्थरचरणविहारम् <ls>Gīt. 11</ls>; <ls>Śi. 6. 40</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">7. 18</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">5. 62</ls>; <ls>R. 19. 21</ls>. .²2 Stupid, foolish, silly; मन्थरकौलिकः. .²3 Low, deep, hollow, having a low tone. .²4 Large, broad, wide, big. .²5 Bent, crooked, curved. .²6 Indicating, showing (सूचक). .{@-रः@} .²1 A store, treasure. .²2 The hair of the head. .²3 Wrath, anger. .²4 Fresh butter. .²5 A churning-stick. .²6 Hindrance, an obstacle. .²7 A stronghold. .²8 Fruit. .²9 A spy, an informer. .²10 The month Vaiśākha. .²11 The mountain Mandara. .²12 An antelope. .{@-रा@} <ab>N.</ab> of a hump-backed nurse or slave of Kaikeyī who instigated her mistress, on the eve of Rāmaʼs coronation as heir-apparent, to beg of her husband by the two boons formerly promised to her by him, the banishment of Rāma for fourteen years and the installation of Bharata on the throne; मन्थरां प्रविशस्वादौ कैकेयीं च ततः परम् <ls>A. Rām.</ls> .{@-रम्@} Safflower.
